Item Name: Adafruit MicroSD SPI or SDIO Breakout Board

Notes: Literally almost any wire will work for this, don't worry!
The cost of the parts themselves to print is basically nothing
The velcro goes on top of the microcontroller base, beneath the battery and beneath the buttons
16gb is honestly overkill, you can use less and you'll probably be fine as plain text takes up very little space
SD, Adafruit BusIO, Adafruit EPD, Adafruit GFX Library, GxEPD2
